Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib && python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, pathlib
p='/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer'
for name,data in [('a.vcf', b'##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\ts1\n1\t1\t.\tA\tC\t.\t.\t.\tGT\t0/1\n')]:
    path='/tmp/'+name
    open(path,'wb').write(data)
    r=subprocess.run([p,path],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    print(name,'rc=',r.returncode,'out=',r.stdout.decode(errors='ignore')[:300].replace('\n',' | '))
PY
